title: Number of Even and Odd Bits
summary: Given a positive integer n, determine the count of 1s at even and odd indices in its binary representation.
statement: Given a positive integer n, determine the count of 1s at even and odd indices in its binary representation. Return the counts as an array [even, odd].
constraints: Index binary bits from zero at the least significant bit.
Count set bits separately at even and odd indices.
hints: Read bits from least significant to most significant by shifting right.
Maintain a parity index beginning at even zero.
Add the current low bit to that bucket, then toggle the parity.
Every shift advances exactly one binary position, so each set bit reaches its correct parity count.
editorial: Every shift advances exactly one binary position, so each set bit reaches its correct parity count.

tests.explanation: Binary 110010 has one set bit at an even index and two at odd indices.
Binary 10 has its only set bit at odd index one, yielding [0,1].
